description: This Java source file defines the EnforcedThingMapper class, which maps JSON representations of 'Thing' objects into BSON documents suitable for indexing, including handling of permissions, metadata, and array pruning.

classes.name: EnforcedThingMapper
classes.description: Utility class for mapping 'Thing' JSON objects with enforcement context into BSON documents for search indexing.

methods.name: mapThing
methods.description: Maps a 'Thing' JSON object into a BSON document for search indexing, using enforcement and policy revision.

methods.name: toWriteModel
methods.description: Converts a 'Thing' JSON object into a write model, including metadata and flattened data, with optional array size limiting.

methods.name: getGlobalRead
methods.description: Retrieves a BSON array of subject IDs with read permission from the enforcer.

methods.name: pruneArrays
methods.description: Truncates large arrays in the JSON 'Thing' object based on maxArraySize.
